text:
Elaine (PM): Heads-up — big RFP from AtlasCorp. They want SOC2 + GDPR assurances before pilot. Sales pushing for fast ship of Feature X too. Thoughts on sequencing?
Marco (Sales): AtlasCorp is live-midyear. If we don't agree SOC2 they walk. Feature X is nice-to-have for them but not dealbreaker.
Priya (Legal): We'll need data processing addendum for GDPR. SOC2 controls reduce legal risk but takes time. Could carve out non-PII flows.
Raj (Security): Full SOC2 in ~4-5 months given current backlog. We can do a scoped "SOC2-lite" package (logging + access controls + encrypted backups) in ~6-8 weeks as a stopgap.
Sam (Eng): Curious what "SOC2-lite" covers. If it's just auth, audit, and backups we can deliver a minimal set without infra rewrite. But it will add sprint load.
Zoe (Design): If we ship a carveout, UI needs clear messaging: "Pilot customers only — limited support for regulated data". Keeps expectations aligned.
Olivia (Customer Success): AtlasCorp values timeline. They'd accept a security carveout if we sign contract language and commit to roadmap dates.
Elaine (PM): Trying to make this concrete. Quick RICE sketch (very rough):
`Option A: Build Feature X -> Reach=6, Impact=8, Confidence=0.6, Effort=10 => RICE≈(6*8*0.6)/10=2.9`
`Option B: SOC2-lite rollout -> Reach=8, Impact=9, Confidence=0.7, Effort=6 => RICE≈(8*9*0.7)/6=8.4`
Priya (Legal): Love that quick calc. Confidence for SOC2-lite depends on evidence (audit logs, policy docs). We should specify acceptance criteria.
Raj (Security): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) central audit logging with 90d retention, 2) role-based access controls, 3) encrypted at rest + key lifecycle, 4) documented incident response runbook.
Sam (Eng): Those four are doable in 2 sprints if we deprioritize small feature work. Need approval to reassign 2 backend engineers.
Marco (Sales): If we can promise SOC2-lite features + signed contract within 8 weeks, I'll close AtlasCorp. They push budget for Dedicated next quarter.
oncall-bot: Reminder: reassigning engineers requires manager OK and sprint capacity update.
Elaine (PM): Proposal: 8-week SOC2-lite sprint, freeze Feature X for now, do a canary contract for AtlasCorp with carveouts. After canary, start formal SOC2 cert process as Q3 item.
Zoe (Design): I'll draft the UI copy for carveouts and the customer-facing FAQ.
Olivia (Customer Success): I'll prep negotiation points and get AtlasCorp to sign the pilot contract template we used with BetaClient.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft the DPA + carveout clauses and a timeline commitment. Need product to confirm acceptance criteria before I finalize.
Sam (Eng): If managers OK, we can start infra prep next week. Quick blocker: need KMS access and audit indexing schema.
Raj (Security): I'll create the checklist artifact and pair with Sam on KMS decisions.
Marco (Sales): Great — can we get a one-pager for the exec sponsor with milestones and risks? I can use that in negotiation.
Elaine (PM): I'll produce the one-pager by EOD tomorrow. Quick call to align tomorrow 10am?
Marco (Sales): 10am works. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): In.
Raj (Security): In.
Sam (Eng): In.
Zoe (Design): In.
Olivia (Customer Success): In.
Elaine (PM): Thanks everyone — leaning toward SOC2-lite first (higher RICE, de-risks legal). We'll treat Feature X as follow-up. If anything changes ping thread. :rocket:
